scenes.say: Quick quiz. Does six by six vision mean your eyes are perfect?

scenes.en: A) 100% perfect eyes  B) No glasses ever  C) Normal sharpness at 6 metres
scenes.say: Is it A, one hundred percent perfect eyes? B, you will never need glasses? Or C, normal sharpness at six metres?

scenes.en: You read at 6 metres what a normal eye reads at 6 metres.
scenes.ta: 6 மீட்டரில் சாதாரண கண் படிப்பதை நீங்களும் படிக்கிறீர்கள்
scenes.say: The answer is C. The top six is the distance you stand from the chart, six metres. The bottom six means a typical healthy eye could read that same line from six metres.

scenes.en: You need to be at 6 m to read what others read from 12 m.
scenes.say: So six by twelve means you must stand at six metres to read what a typical eye reads from twelve metres. In America, the same idea is called twenty by twenty.

scenes.en: Not checked by the chart: eye pressure, side vision, retina, near vision
scenes.ta: அழுத்தம், பக்க பார்வை, விழித்திரை தனியாக சோதிக்க வேண்டும்
scenes.say: But the chart does not check eye pressure, side vision, the retina, or reading vision up close.

scenes.en: Glaucoma can steal side vision while you still read 6/6.
scenes.say: Did you know? Glaucoma can slowly damage side vision, while you still read six by six on the chart.
So know your number, and more. Book a full eye test.
